CustomField.description:
Tanium is launching a Limited Support offering for on-premise customers ONLY, that begins after the end of our Standard Support terms, which are defined against the software versions in our semi-annual release (SAR) bundles. SAR bundles are released every 6 months and have names such as 2024H1, 2024H2, 2025H1, etc.
When an on-premise customer purchases Limited Support, they can only purchase Limited Support against a subset of their endpoints (not their entire enterprise quantity), and it must be pinned to a specific SAR version for the duration of the Limited Support term). Business Owner: Jeff Kopp
